Profit and Loss Statement Account — Edit

The Profit and Loss Statement Account form is used to create income and expense accounts.

These accounts track revenues and expenses for profitability reporting.

This form contains the following fields:

Name

The name of the account as it will appear in reports and transaction forms. Choose a descriptive name that clearly identifies the type of revenue or expense.

Code

An optional account code for organizing and referencing accounts. Codes typically follow a numbering system (e.g., 4000-4999 for revenue, 5000-5999 for expenses).

Group

Assign this account to a group for better organization in reports. Groups help categorize similar accounts together (e.g., 'Sales Revenue', 'Operating Expenses').

Cash Flow Statement

Specify how this account should be categorized in the Cash Flow Statement. Most revenue and expense accounts are classified as Operating Activities.

CashFlowStatementOperatingActivityGroup

Select the specific operating activity group for this account in the Cash Flow Statement.

CashFlowStatementFinancingActivityGroup

Select the specific financing activity group for this account in the Cash Flow Statement.

CashFlowStatementInvestingActivityGroup

Select the specific investing activity group for this account in the Cash Flow Statement.

Autofill — Line description

Enable this to automatically fill in a default description when this account is selected in transactions.

DefaultLineDescription

The default description that will be automatically filled when this account is used in transactions. This saves time and ensures consistency.

Autofill — Tax Code

Enable this to automatically select a default tax code when this account is used in transactions.

DefaultTaxCode

The default tax code that will be automatically selected when this account is used. This ensures the correct tax treatment is applied.

Position

The display order of this account within its group. Lower numbers appear first. Use this to customize the sequence of accounts in reports.

Inactive

Check this box to make the account inactive. Inactive accounts won't appear in selection lists but historical transactions remain unchanged.
